display.purpose: The one-line equity or day P&L. Tabular, no wrap.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Silver inset plus a soft drop under frosted plates.

components.name: Account trigger
components.description: Current paper account. Opens the list.
components.css: .acct-trigger { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(228,194,122,.42); background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.12), rgba(255,255,255,.03)); color:#f7f2e8; } .acct-badge.live { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f3d7a4,#d7b36a); color:#1c1508; border-radius:999px; padding:2px 7px; font-style:normal; }

components.name: Glass panel
components.description: Frosted plate for a desk section.
components.css: .ops-pane { background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.1), rgba(255,255,255,.03) 36%, rgba(14,16,22,.55)); border:1px solid rgba(228,194,122,.38); border-radius:18px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(213,216,224,.34), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.2); color:#f7f2e8; padding:12px 14px; }
